proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_multi_spawn
proposed_widenings.justification: A collection variant can summon multiple independent creatures from one item, but magic-item mechanics only support a single spawned companion payload.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use one figurine or both simultaneously. Each can become a Lion for up to 1 hour.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics.spawnCountChoice
proposed_widenings.justification: The item needs a bounded one-or-both summon choice without being split into fake separate records.
proposed_widenings.evidence: These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously.

proposed_widenings.name: time_based_active_form_charge_drain
proposed_widenings.justification: The current activation resource model spends charges at activation time; it cannot express charges draining per elapsed hour while the transformed creature remains active.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The unit is a magic-item collection whose variants exceed the existing single-companion magic-item family; forcing it into one spawned_creature record would produce a misleading trace.
